title: Dates, times and time zones
objectives: Filter timestamps with a half-open range instead of casting them
Turn a local day into the UTC range it covers
Keep the column bare so the engine can skip data

exercises.prompt: Sales are stored in UTC. Give the total amount sold on 31 October 2026 in New York, where that day ran from 04:00 UTC on 31 October to 04:00 UTC on 1 November. One column, total.
hints: The starter adds up the UTC day. Which sales fall on 31 October in UTC but not in New York, and the other way round?
Compare sold_at itself with two timestamps: from 2026-10-31 04:00 up to, but not including, 2026-11-01 04:00.
